newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka adjusted downward against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka adjusted downward against dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh currency taka has been readjusted downward against U.S. dollar to 43.55/75 from 43.10/30 effective on Monday, a Bangladesh Bank (central bank) circular said on Sunday.
The central bank gave no explanation for the downward adjustment of the taka twice in 18 days.

Officials with commercial banks said the central bank's move was aimed at boosting the country's exports. The country's exporters of garments, which fetch about $2.0 billion annually, have been demanding for "devaluation" of the currency to stay competitive in international market.
The taka was last adjusted downwards on March 19.
